name: graf rats
mana cost: {1}{B}
types: creature rat
power toughness: 2/1
triggered: at the beginning of combat on your turn, if you both own and control CARDNAME and a creature named midnight scavengers, exile them, then meld them into chittering host.

ALTERNATE

name: chittering host
types: creature eldrazi horror
power toughness: 5/6
static: haste
static: menace
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and menace until end of turn.
